instruction: A clean studio portrait photograph captured in a medium shot at eye-level against a plain white background. On the left, the blonde woman in the beige long-sleeve top (R1) stands facing forward, smiling warmly at the camera. Beside her on the right, the brunette woman in the grey-brown long-sleeve top (R2) stands facing forward, also smiling warmly. The blonde woman (R1) has her left arm draped over the shoulder of the brunette woman (R2) as they stand close together. The scene is illuminated by bright, even studio lighting with soft shadows, creating a clean and minimalist aesthetic.
